C0140.title: Qufu Police Crack Novel Personal Information Infringement Case, Arresting Man Trading in Stolen Game Accounts
C0140.summary: In January 2025, Tencent’s game security team reported that it had assisted Qufu police in Shandong in cracking a game-account theft case. The criminal group obtained players’ login-state data to bypass account-password verification and steal game accounts and virtual equipment. Police arrested 10 suspects, and the case value exceeded 30 million yuan. The case shows the risk of session-state data and virtual assets being stolen in bulk for gray-market trading.
